result.title: Ego2Wrist: Bootstrapping Wrist-View Synthesis from Egocentric Video
result.comment: 27 pages (13 main + 14 appendix), 9 figures, 20 tables. Project page: https://adonis-galaxy.github.io/Ego2Wrist/
result.summary: Wrist cameras provide an action-centric view that is directly relevant to robot manipulation. However, collecting human wrist-camera videos at scale is challenging due to cumbersome setups that can interfere with natural hand movements. In contrast, head-mounted human egocentric videos are much easier to scale. We introduce Ego2Wrist, which synthesizes synchronized wrist-camera views from human egocentric videos and task descriptions. Trained on approximately 940 hours of paired head- and wrist-camera recordings, Ego2Wrist jointly generates three views. To evaluate generated wrist views without ground truth, we propose hand-centric cross-view consistency (HCC), which measures consistency between generated wrist views and corresponding hand regions in the input head view. HCC ranks model checkpoints comparably to ground-truth-based LPIPS, and human evaluators prefer HCC-selected generations in 77% of responses. Evaluated on four datasets, Ego2Wrist outperforms fine-tuned WorldWander, reducing LPIPS by 28% and receiving human preference in 76% of responses. More importantly, HCC facilitates recursive self-improvement on in-the-wild egocentric videos by selecting generated wrist views for further training. Generation quality progressively improves over three rounds. These results demonstrate a scalable approach to generating real-world wrist-view human manipulation videos for robot policy training.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Ego2Wrist，从人类头戴式自我中心视频与任务描述合成同步的腕部视角视频并联合生成三视角，同时给出无真值的手部中心跨视角一致性指标 HCC，用于模型选择与生成样本的递归自训练筛选。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用跨视角一致性替代真值来验证生成观察、并据此筛选样本递归改进的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据是否保真、以及训练监督如何筛选的问题；但任务本体是视频生成与机器人数据扩增，与 latent 推理状态无直接联系。
